name: 68th Hyundai Filmfare Awards 2023 with Maharashtra Tourism
original_name: 68th Hyundai Filmfare Awards 2023 with Maharashtra Tourism
overview: The 68th Hyundai Filmfare Awards 2023, presented by The Times Group in association with Maharashtra Tourism, honored the best Indian Hindi-language films of 2022. The prestigious ceremony was held at the Jio World Convention Centre in Mumbai and featured spectacular performances by Bollywood stars, hosted by Salman Khan, Ayushmann Khurrana, and Maniesh Paul.
